      "time": "2014-10-10T22:55:52Z",
      "text": "User Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; rv:32.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/32.0\nBuild ID: 20140923175406\n\nSteps to reproduce:\n\nI used exportFunction() to create a callable function in the unprivileged (unsafeWindow) context. In the loaded document I accessed the .length attribute of this function\n\n\nActual results:\n\nI got a value of 0.\n\n\nExpected results:\n\nThe real number of arguments of the exported function should be returned.",
      "raw_text": "User Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; rv:32.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/32.0\nBuild ID: 20140923175406\n\nSteps to reproduce:\n\nI used exportFunction() to create a callable function in the unprivileged (unsafeWindow) context. In the loaded document I accessed the .length attribute of this function\n\n\nActual results:\n\nI got a value of 0.\n\n\nExpected results:\n\nThe real number of arguments of the exported function should be returned.",
      "attachment_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": 9545034,
      "count": 1,
      "creation_time": "2014-11-04T19:47:34Z",
      "time": "2014-11-04T19:47:34Z",
      "text": "Gabor, can you look at this and put it in the right component?",
      "raw_text": "Gabor, can you look at this and put it in the right component?",
      "attachment_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": 9548627,
      "count": 2,
      "creation_time": "2014-11-05T12:33:54Z",
      "time": "2014-11-05T12:33:54Z",
      "text": "I think the fix is to get the length of the |callable| here http://mxr.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/source/js/xpconnect/src/ExportHelpers.cpp#330 and then pass it to NewFunctionByIdWithReserved. I think this would be a good first bug candidate.",
      "raw_text": "I think the fix is to get the length of the |callable| here http://mxr.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/source/js/xpconnect/src/ExportHelpers.cpp#330 and then pass it to NewFunctionByIdWithReserved. I think this would be a good first bug candidate.",
      "attachment_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": 9549883,
      "count": 3,
      "creation_time": "2014-11-05T17:25:15Z",
      "time": "2014-11-05T17:25:15Z",
      "text": "Do we want to just do .length, or JS_GetFunctionArity combined with JS_GetObjectFunction (and bail on non-function callables, but get \"saner\" results for functions if someone mucked with .length on them)?",
      "raw_text": "Do we want to just do .length, or JS_GetFunctionArity combined with JS_GetObjectFunction (and bail on non-function callables, but get \"saner\" results for functions if someone mucked with .length on them)?",
      "attachment_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": 9550332,
      "count": 4,
      "creation_time": "2014-11-05T18:43:01Z",
      "time": "2014-11-05T18:43:01Z",
      "text": "(In reply to Boris Zbarsky [:bz] from comment #3)\n> Do we want to just do .length, or JS_GetFunctionArity combined with\n> JS_GetObjectFunction (and bail on non-function callables, but get \"saner\"\n> results for functions if someone mucked with .length on them)?\n\nI would do JS_GetFunctionArity. I don't see any reason to port any mockery on the .length property to the exported version.",
      "raw_text": "(In reply to Boris Zbarsky [:bz] from comment #3)\n> Do we want to just do .length, or JS_GetFunctionArity combined with\n> JS_GetObjectFunction (and bail on non-function callables, but get \"saner\"\n> results for functions if someone mucked with .length on them)?\n\nI would do JS_GetFunctionArity. I don't see any reason to port any mockery on the .length property to the exported version.",
      "attachment_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": 9550693,
      "count": 5,
      "creation_time": "2014-11-05T19:40:47Z",
      "time": "2014-11-05T19:40:47Z",
      "text": "It basically depends on what we want the behavior to be when exporting function proxies or other non-function callables.",
      "raw_text": "It basically depends on what we want the behavior to be when exporting function proxies or other non-function callables.",
      "attachment_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": 12246920,
      "count": 6,
      "creation_time": "2017-04-19T12:53:42Z",
      "time": "2017-04-19T12:53:42Z",
      "text": "Are there any news on this bug?",
      "raw_text": "Are there any news on this bug?",
      "attachment_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": 12247202,
      "count": 7,
      "creation_time": "2017-04-19T14:23:52Z",
      "time": "2017-04-19T14:23:52Z",
      "text": "A bit of background why I think is is important. It allows fingerprinting the browser for addons that use exportFunction() by checking if the length attribute matches the expected value.",
      "raw_text": "A bit of background why I think is is important. It allows fingerprinting the browser for addons that use exportFunction() by checking if the length attribute matches the expected value.",
      "attachment_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": 12507141,
      "count": 8,
      "creation_time": "2017-07-26T08:34:31Z",
      "time": "2017-07-26T08:34:31Z",
      "text": "Not only the value of the length property is wrong but also the property descriptor: ECMA says that [[Configurable]] should be true but after exportFunction it's false.\n\nThis prevents me from fixing this bug on the addon side.",
      "raw_text": "Not only the value of the length property is wrong but also the property descriptor: ECMA says that [[Configurable]] should be true but after exportFunction it's false.\n\nThis prevents me from fixing this bug on the addon side.",
      "attachment_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": 12916975,
      "count": 9,
      "creation_time": "2017-12-13T19:21:37Z",
      "time": "2017-12-13T19:21:37Z",
      "text": "Is this really that hard to fix? Or just not interesting enough?",
      "raw_text": "Is this really that hard to fix? Or just not interesting enough?",
      "attachment_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": 12917174,
      "count": 10,
      "creation_time": "2017-12-13T20:43:56Z",
      "time": "2017-12-13T20:43:56Z",
      "text": "The hard part is that it's not clear what the right fix is for various edge cases.\n\nThat said I'm happy to just make a call on it.  Let's do comment 4.",
      "raw_text": "The hard part is that it's not clear what the right fix is for various edge cases.\n\nThat said I'm happy to just make a call on it.  Let's do comment 4.",
      "attachment_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": 12917600,
      "count": 11,
      "creation_time": "2017-12-13T23:29:07Z",
      "time": "2017-12-13T23:29:07Z",
      "text": "Created attachment 8936711\nGive functions created via exportFunction the same .length as the function being exported\n\nMozReview-Commit-ID: 7NVkm2rqfs4",

      "id": 12918077,
      "count": 13,
      "creation_time": "2017-12-14T10:33:22Z",
      "time": "2017-12-14T10:33:22Z",
      "text": "Comment on attachment 8936711\nGive functions created via exportFunction the same .length as the function being exported\n\nReview of attachment 8936711:\n-----------------------------------------------------------------\n\nThanks for fixing this.\n\n::: js/xpconnect/src/ExportHelpers.cpp\n@@ +334,5 @@\n> +    unsigned nargs = 0;\n> +    RootedObject unwrapped(cx, js::UncheckedUnwrap(callable));\n> +    if (unwrapped) {\n> +        if (JSFunction* fun = JS_GetObjectFunction(unwrapped)) {\n> +            nargs = JS_GetFunctionArity(fun);\n\nNit: I think in js/xpconnect the {} should be avoided for one liner if branches (that used to be the case at least, I haven't been following any coding style discussions lately). Also it might make sense to merge the two if's.",
      "raw_text": "Review of attachment 8936711:\n-----------------------------------------------------------------\n\nThanks for fixing this.\n\n::: js/xpconnect/src/ExportHelpers.cpp\n@@ +334,5 @@\n> +    unsigned nargs = 0;\n> +    RootedObject unwrapped(cx, js::UncheckedUnwrap(callable));\n> +    if (unwrapped) {\n> +        if (JSFunction* fun = JS_GetObjectFunction(unwrapped)) {\n> +            nargs = JS_GetFunctionArity(fun);\n\nNit: I think in js/xpconnect the {} should be avoided for one liner if branches (that used to be the case at least, I haven't been following any coding style discussions lately). Also it might make sense to merge the two if's.",
      "attachment_id": 8936711
    },
